title: DOE check finds no nuclear tests on shutdown dates

tellings.quote: There were no there were no nuclear tests on June or March 16th or March 24th.

plain: There were no nuclear tests at the Nevada test site on the dates in 1967 when nuclear missiles were shut down, including March 16 and March 24, according to a check made with the Department of Energy by a man Robert Salas names as James Clattz. Salas, a former Air Force officer who tells Michels a UFO shut down ten nuclear missiles, raises it to rule out a nuclear test as the cause of the shutdowns.
